translated_document_hindi:
MASTER SERVICES करार

यह मास्टर सेवा करार (\"करार\") इस 15th day of November, 2023 को निम्नलिखित पक्षकारों के मध्य निष्पादित और प्रविष्ट किया गया है:

ALPHA LEGAL TECH PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at Nariman Point, Mumbai - 400021 (hereinafter referred to as the "Service Provider", which expression करेगा include its successors and permitted assigns);

AND

BHARAT COMMERCIAL ENTERPRISES LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at Connaught Place, New Delhi - 110001 (hereinafter referred to as the "Client", which expression करेगा include its successors and permitted assigns).

चूंकि: A. The Service Provider is engaged in the business of providing enterprise software and legal analytics solutions. B. The Client desires to retain the Service Provider, and the Service Provider agrees to render such services on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

अतएव अब, पक्षकार निम्नलिखित रूप से परस्पर सहमत होते हैं:

1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 "Applicable Law" करेगा mean any statute, law, regulation, ordinance, rule, judgment, order, डिक्री, or directive having the force of law in the Republic of India.

1.2 "Confidential Information" करेगा mean all proprietary information disclosed by one Party to the other Party, whether orally or in writing.

2. OBLIGATIONS OF THE SERVICE PROVIDER

2.1 The Service Provider करेगा perform the Services with reasonable skill, care, and diligence in accordance with the specifications set forth in Schedule A.

2.2 The Service Provider नहीं करेगा assign or sub-संविदा any of its obligations without the prior written consent of the Client.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT TERMS

3.1 The Client करेगा pay the Service Provider a total प्रतिफल of ₹15,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Fifteen Lakhs only) plus applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST) within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of an undisputed invoice.

3.2 Any delayed payment करेगा attract interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the due date until the date of actual payment.

4. INDEMNIFICATION AND LIABILITY

4.1 The Service Provider करेगा indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Client, its directo₹, office₹, and employees against any third-party claims, liabilities, losses, damages, and expenses arising directly out of any willful misconduct or breach of गोपनीयता by the Service Provider. (rs,)

4.2 In no event नहीं करेगा the total aggregate liability of either Party under this करार exceed ₹30,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Thirty Lakhs only).

5. समाप्ति

5.1 Either Party कर सकता है terminate this करार तत्काल by giving written सूचना of thirty (30) days in the event of a material breach by the other Party which remains uncured for fifteen (15) days after receipt of सूचना.

5.2 Upon समाप्ति, the Client करेगा तत्काल pay all outstanding fees accrued up to the effective date of समाप्ति.

6. शासी विधि AND विवाद समाधान

6.1 यह करार भारत की विधियों द्वारा शासित और उनके अनुसार अर्थान्वित होगा।

6.2 इस करार से उत्पन्न या इसके संबंध में होने वाले किसी भी विवाद को the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 के अनुसार मध्यस्थता के लिए संदर्भित किया जाएगा। मध्यस्थता का स्थान और विचार-स्थल New Delhi होगा, तथा कार्यवाही एकल मध्यस्थ के समक्ष अंग्रेजी भाषा में संचालित की जाएगी।

6.3 The Courts at New Delhi करेगा have exclusive क्षेत्राधिकार over all matters arising hereunder.
